# prism-plugin (generated)

Thin, self-contained plugin mirror of **Prism** (https://github.com/TheDigitalGriot/prism).

**Do not edit here.** This folder is populated by `scripts/sync-to-marketplace.sh`,
run from the Prism repo on release (closing ceremony). It carries only the plugin
dirs — `.claude-plugin/`, `skills/`, `agents/`, `commands/`, `hooks/`, `scripts/` —
not the multi-GB app source. The root `../.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` lists it
with a `./prism-plugin` source.

> Scaffold note: at first commit this folder holds only `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
> to establish the shape. The full contents land the first time the sync script runs
> from the Prism repo.
